fusions.name: Roasting Cluster
fusions.desc: Sends the swarm to cluster around an enemy at or below 25% health: the swarm deals 18 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Needle Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 4 burning stingers in a spread, each of which deals 2 damage. Their damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Keeper's Hush
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3.5 tiles in place for 4 seconds and leaves each [Hindered], its attacks slowed, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Candlewax Drone
fusions.desc: A bonded ember-bee flies with you. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 3 damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
